description: This Java source file defines a data transfer object (DTO) named CategoryResponse, which represents category data including localized descriptions within a catalog service. It includes nested class LocalizedText for localized string data and uses annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: CategoryResponse
classes.description: A record that encapsulates category details including IDs, code, sorting, visibility, parent info, localized descriptions, and timestamps.

classes.name: LocalizedText
classes.description: A nested record within CategoryResponse representing localized string data with language ID, name, description, and friendly URL.
